other_mijikenda: Duruma, Giriama: same name (Pakia App. VI)

teaser.en: A thorny acacia whose name is shared by Digo, Duruma, Giriama and Swahili alike.
teaser.sw: Mgunga wenye miiba ambao jina lake linashirikiwa na Kidigo, Kiduruma, Kigiriama na Kiswahili kwa pamoja.
teaser.dg: *Mgunga* ni *acacia* yenye miya, na dzinare ni sawa kpwa Chidigo, Chiduruma, Chigiriama na Chiswahili.

summary.en: Mgunga is a small thorny acacia of dry bushland, recognised by Digo speakers from its feathery leaves. Its name is one of the few that Digo shares with Duruma, Giriama and Swahili.
summary.sw: Mgunga ni mgunga mdogo wenye miiba wa nyika kavu ya vichaka, unaotambuliwa na wasemaji wa Kidigo kwa majani yake kama manyoya. Jina lake ni mojawapo ya machache ambayo Kidigo linashiriki na Kiduruma, Kigiriama na Kiswahili.
summary.dg: *Mgunga* ni *acacia* ndide yenye miya ya weruni kukavu, na atu anaogomba Chidigo nkuimanya kpwa makodzage ganayohalana na manyoya. Dzinare ni mwenga wa madzina machache ambago Chidigo chinahumira sawa na Chiduruma, Chigiriama na Chiswahili.

about.en:
*Mgunga* is a small acacia, a shrub or low tree with a spreading crown. Its branches carry pairs of straight, sharp spines at the base of the leaves, and the leaves are finely divided into many small leaflets, like feathers. Small round heads of cream or white flowers appear before or with the new leaves, and they ripen into flat pods.

Pakia's informants identified it from the look of its leaves.
about.sw:
*Mgunga* ni mgunga (acacia) mdogo, kichaka au mti mfupi wenye taji lililotandaa. Matawi yake yana jozi za miiba iliyonyooka na mikali kwenye vitako vya majani, na majani yamegawanyika kuwa vijani vingi vidogo, kama manyoya. Vichwa vidogo vya mviringo vya maua ya rangi ya krimu au meupe huchipuka kabla ya majani mapya au pamoja nayo, na hukomaa yakawa maganda bapa.

Watoa taarifa wa Pakia waliutambua kwa sura ya majani yake.
about.dg:
*Mgunga* ni *acacia* ndide, chitsaka au muhi mfupi wenye chitswa chinachotandazika. Pandaze zina miya miiri-miiri iriyogoloka na yenye ntsa, phatu makodza ganapholungana na panda, na makodza ganaganywa sana kukala makodza madide manji, dza manyoya. Vitswa vidide vya mviringo vya maruwa ga rangi ya maziya au ga nyereru vinazuka kabla ya makodza maphya au phamwenga nago, na bada yakpwe kunazuka makakaya sambamba.

Atu ariouzwa ni Pakia akaumanya kpwa umbo ra makodzage.

where.en: It grows in dry bushland and wooded grassland. On the south coast it belongs with the other acacias of the drier bush away from the shore and forest.
where.sw: Hukua katika nyika kavu ya vichaka na nyasi zenye miti. Katika pwani ya kusini uko pamoja na migunga mingine ya vichaka vikavu zaidi vilivyo mbali na ufuo na misitu.
where.dg: Unamera weruni kukavu na kpwenye nyasi zenye mihi. Kpwa pwani ya kusini unamera phamwenga na *acacia* zanjina za weruni kukavu zaidi, kure na ufuwo na matsaka.

culture.en: Digo speakers treat the acacias as a loose group of related plants, even though there is no single word for them. Pakia calls this a 'covert category'. *Chikwata* is the general name for acacia species.
culture.sw: Wasemaji wa Kidigo huichukulia migunga kuwa kundi lisilo rasmi la mimea inayohusiana, ingawa hakuna neno moja la kuiita. Pakia analiita hili 'kundi lililojificha' (covert category). *Chikwata* ni jina la jumla la spishi za migunga.
culture.dg: Atu anaogomba Chidigo nkuona *acacia* dza kundi ra mimea ya kuhalana, hata kukala takuna neno mwenga ra kuziiha zosi. Pakia anaiha kundi hiri 'covert category', maana kundi risiro na dzina. *Chikwata* ni dzina ra kawaida ra aina za *acacia*.

names.en: Pakia gives *mgunga* as the Digo name and notes that Duruma, Giriama and Swahili use the same word. In Swahili, *mgunga* is also a general word for acacias. Pakia gives the English name as 'fever tree', but that name usually belongs to a different species, *Acacia xanthophloea*. Botanists now often place this species in the genus *Vachellia*.
names.sw: Pakia anatoa *mgunga* kama jina la Kidigo na anabainisha kwamba Kiduruma, Kigiriama na Kiswahili hutumia neno hilo hilo. Kwa Kiswahili, *mgunga* pia ni neno la jumla la migunga yote. Pakia anatoa jina la Kiingereza kuwa *fever tree*, lakini jina hilo kwa kawaida ni la spishi nyingine, *Acacia xanthophloea*. Siku hizi wataalamu wa mimea mara nyingi huiweka spishi hii katika jenasi *Vachellia*.
names.dg: Pakia analavya *mgunga* dza dzina ra Chidigo na anaandika kukala Chiduruma, Chigiriama na Chiswahili vinahumira neno hiri hiri. Kpwa Chiswahili, *mgunga* piya ni neno ra kuiha *acacia* zosi. Pakia anapha dzina ra Chingereza dza 'fever tree', ela dzina hiro mara nyinji ni ra aina yanjina, *Acacia xanthophloea*. Asayansi a mimea sambi mara nyinji anaika aina hino kpwenye jenasi ya *Vachellia*.
